package versions

// Go 1.26: new with an expression operand.
func g() int { return 1 }

func ptr() *int { return new(g()) }

// Go 1.26: a generic type naming itself in its type parameter list.
type Adder[A Adder[A]] interface{ Add(A) A }

func algo[A Adder[A]](x, y A) A { return x.Add(y) }

// Go 1.27: a method with its own type parameters.
type Stack[T any] struct{ items []T }

func (s *Stack[T]) Map[U any](f func(T) U) *Stack[U] {
	out := &Stack[U]{}
	for _, it := range s.items {
		out.items = append(out.items, f(it))
	}
	return out
}

func h(n int) int { return n }

func use(s *Stack[int]) *Stack[int] { return s.Map[int](h) }

// Go 1.27: a struct literal keyed by a promoted field.
type Inner struct{ B int }

type Outer struct{ Inner }

func v() int { return 2 }

func build() Outer { return Outer{B: v()} }

// Go 1.27: function type inference in an assignment.
func id[T any](x T) T { return x }

var hf func(int) int = id
